components_and_features: 7-second cinematic loading screen with gold shimmer and logo
Sticky glass navbar with backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0A0A]/80 border-b border-[#D4A853]/20
Home page with hero showcase, interactive lesson selector, trust stats, and student testimonials
Lessons page detailing beginner, intensive, motorway, pass plus, and refresher courses
Pricing & Plans page with transparent block pricing and Firestore instant booking / plan enquiry
Contact page with interactive form writing directly to Firebase Firestore messages collection
Dynamic ratings and reviews pulled live from Firestore with star rating submission
Admin dashboard route /adevglobpik with Firebase email/password auth (adevbossCDSuk@gmail.in / uk#1CDSleg)
Admin CRUD management for lessons, pricing plans, contact messages, dynamic ratings, site settings, and maintenance mode
WhatsApp floating action button with direct chat link for Northampton students
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Use Firebase SDKs directly from React frontend for all data operations (lessons, plans, messages, ratings, settings, admin auth). Do NOT use MongoDB or custom FastAPI backend.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for robust automated testing.
Ensure dark theme (#0A0A0A / #151515) with rich gold accents (#D4A853, #F0D48B) across all pages.
Never use complete transparent background in headers or overlays; ensure solid or glassmorphism background with proper contrast.
Apply Poppins for headings and Inter for body copy.
